finding: head-only denylist bypass via value aliasing
discovered_by: standalone classifier sweep over the evasion battery, before the server run
root_cause: WGClassify matched danger-set membership against call HEADS only (Cases[held, h_Symbol[___] ...]). DeleteFile here appears as the value bound to g, not as a call head, so the head scan missed it; the aliased call g[path] then deletes the file. The same class defeats any head-only check: pass the dangerous function as a value and call the alias.
fix: Test danger-set membership against EVERY symbol that appears anywhere in the parsed code (names), not just call heads. Strictly more conservative; a legitimate read task references none of the dangerous symbols, so it is unaffected (verified: the SELECT-count read still classifies 'allow').
code_change: WolframGuard.wl: IntersectingQ[heads, $set] -> IntersectingQ[names, $set] for FilesystemWrite/Process/Network/InstallOrEnv/sqlHeads (Java/DynamicEval already used names).
reproduce_before: In WolframGuard.wl change the five 'names' checks back to 'heads', then run: wolfram -script over WGClassify["With[{g = DeleteFile}, g[\"x\"]]"] -> decision 'allow'. Restore 'names' -> 'block'.
